definition.title: Staked validation storage: canonical rejection and alternative inclusion
definition.expectedInvariant: Foreign validation storage requires an actually staked entity at the sidecar; canonical rejection persists after staking, while the sidecar admits and executes the same signed staked candidate without waivers.
preconditions: Owned isolated mining fixture with automatic sidecar inclusion
Pinned upstream wallet, Foreign and registry deployment bytes; no new Solidity
Actual registry stake/delay and successful state-changing frame receipts

limitations: Reuses pinned upstream wallet/storage/registry deployment artifacts; no new Solidity or local contract compilation is claimed. Automatic inclusion is performed by the isolated upstream sidecar.
Fresh staged-fork mining fixture; manual sidecar bundling and ordinary canonical transfers.
Seed identifies action order, not private signing keys; fresh accounts are random.
Only the explicitly defined actions are checked; terminal/TTL and submitted-entry exceptions are outside this run.
